points.apply: Before speaking in a meeting or a group this week, ask whether your words will build up.

points.h: Do not be afraid, little flock
sub: Treasure in heaven, heart in heaven.
q: do not fear, for I am with you, do not be afraid, for I am your God; I will strengthen you, I will help you, I will uphold you with my victorious right hand.
“Do not be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
points.apply: Each night this week, hand one worry to the Father, and give one alms you had not planned.

concl: Fear and presumption both fail the test of trust; the Father who went before Israel goes before his little flock today.
Refined by his fire and built up in love, we can strive for the kingdom without anxiety, because our treasure and our heart are with him.
2027-06-13.resolve: This week, take one step of trust, help one person in need, speak only to build up, and give each worry to the Father in prayer.

intro: Theme: “For the kingdom of God depends not on talk but on power.”
A father in the faith, the power of the Spirit that changes lives, the little ones whom Jesus defends, and St Justin, who found the truth in Christ.

q: Recite them to your children and talk about them when you are at home and when you are away, when you lie down and when you rise.
For though you might have ten thousand guardians in Christ, you do not have many fathers. Indeed, in Christ Jesus I became your father through the gospel.
points.apply: Pray once this week with a child, slowly and aloud.

q: He said to me, “This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel: Not by might, nor by power, but by my spirit, says the Lord of hosts.
For the kingdom of God depends not on talk but on power.
points.apply: Ask the Holy Spirit each morning this week for one concrete change in your life.

points.h: Woe to the one who causes the little ones to stumble
q: I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the strayed, and I will bind up the injured, and I will strengthen the weak, but the fat and the strong I will destroy. I will feed them with justice.

If any of you put a stumbling block before one of these little ones who believe in me, it would be better for you if a great millstone were fastened around your neck and you were drowned in the depth of the sea.
points.apply: Remove one occasion of sin from your life this week.

concl: The faith is handed on by fathers and mothers whose lives can be copied, and the kingdom is shown in the Spirit's power.
With St Justin, let our Amen be sealed by a life that witnesses to Christ.
2027-06-01.resolve: This week, pray with a child, protect the little ones, and cut off one thing that leads you into sin.

intro: Theme: “It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is truly the Savior of the world.”
The witness of the woman at the well, the Samaritans who heard Jesus for themselves, God at work in us, and Christians who shine like stars.

sub: Not a sermon but a story.
q: Then they said to one another, “What we are doing is wrong. This is a day of good news; if we are silent and wait until the morning light, we will be found guilty; therefore let us go and tell the king’s household.”
Many Samaritans from that city believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me everything I have ever done.”
points.apply: Tell one person this week what the Lord has done for you.

sub: Faith grows in time spent with him.
The Saviour of the world, recognised by outsiders.
q: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you;
They said to the woman, “It is no longer because of what you said that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is truly the Savior of the world.”
points.apply: Give Jesus ten extra minutes of prayer on two days this week.

q: I will put my spirit within you, and make you follow my statutes and be careful to observe my ordinances.
for it is God who is at work in you, enabling you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.
points.apply: Each morning this week ask God for the will and the strength to do one good thing, and do it.

sub: Holding fast to the word of life.
q: Those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
so that you may be blameless and innocent, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine like stars in the world.
points.apply: Spend one whole day without complaining.

concl: The woman's word brought the Samaritans to Jesus; his own word made them believers.
God at work in us makes us lights in the world when we hold fast to the word of life.
2027-06-02.resolve: This week, tell your story of faith, give Jesus time to stay with you, and shine without murmuring.

intro: Theme: “But as for that in the good soil, these are the ones who, when they hear the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patient endurance.”
The generous sower, the soils of the heart, the God who gives the growth, and the patient endurance of the martyrs.

sub: I belong to Paul, I belong to Apollos.
q: How very good and pleasant it is when kindred live together in unity!
I planted, Apollos watered, but God gave the growth.
points.apply: Refuse to take part in any talk that divides your parish into parties.

points.h: The seed is the word of God
sub: The path where the devil steals the word.
q: so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
“Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.
points.apply: Keep one sentence of Sunday's Gospel all week.

q: For thus says the Lord to the people of Judah and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Break up your fallow ground, and do not sow among thorns.
As for what fell among the thorns, these are the ones who hear; but as they go on their way, they are choked by the cares and riches and pleasures of life, and their fruit does not mature.
points.apply: Name the thorn that chokes your prayer and offer it to God.

q: May those who sow in tears reap with shouts of joy.
But as for that in the good soil, these are the ones who, when they hear the word, hold it fast in an honest and good heart, and bear fruit with patient endurance.
points.apply: Persevere in one good practice this week even if you see no fruit.

concl: God sows generously; our hearts decide what becomes of the seed.
United as God's field, and patient like the martyrs, we will bear fruit a hundredfold.
2027-06-03.resolve: This week, keep the word, clear one thorn, and refuse every faction.

intro: Theme: “Instead, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.”
On the Feast of the Sacred Heart and First Friday: Abram's peacemaking heart, the wounded Servant, faith believed in the heart and confessed with the lips, and the fountain opened on Calvary.

sub: God is not outdone in generosity.
q: Then Abram said to Lot, “Let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herders and my herders; for we are kindred.
Let each of you look not to your own interests, but to the interests of others.
points.apply: Take one step toward peace in a family quarrel, even at a cost to yourself.

sub: Philip preaches the Servant as Jesus.
q: But he was wounded for our transgressions, crushed for our iniquities; upon him was the punishment that made us whole, and by his bruises we are healed.
But God proves his love for us in that while we still were sinners Christ died for us.
points.apply: Bring one hidden wound to the Lord in confession this First Friday.

sub: Believe in the heart, confess with the lips.
q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
For one believes with the heart and so is justified, and one confesses with the mouth and so is saved.
points.apply: Make the sign of the cross and pray before every meal this week, also in public.

q: On that day a fountain shall be opened for the house of David and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, to cleanse them from sin and impurity.
Instead, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once blood and water came out.
points.apply: Renew the consecration of your family to the Sacred Heart this evening.

concl: The Heart of Jesus is gentle and humble, wounded for us, believed and confessed, and opened as the fountain of the sacraments.
Like Thomas, invited to that wounded side, let us say, My Lord and my God.
2027-06-04.resolve: This First Friday, go to confession and Holy Qurbana, renew the family consecration, and make peace where there is strife.

intro: Theme: “His mother treasured all these things in her heart.”
On the Feast of the Immaculate Heart of Mary: Sarah, mother of nations; the sign of Immanuel; the Virgin chosen to be holy and blameless; and the heart that kept God's word in the dark.

q: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. I will bless her, and she shall give rise to nations; kings of peoples shall come from her.
For nothing will be impossible with God.
points.apply: Entrust to God, through Mary, one situation that seems impossible.

points.h: The Lord himself will give you a sign
q: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Look, the young woman is with child and shall bear a son, and shall name him Immanuel.
“Look, the virgin shall conceive and bear a son, and they shall name him Emmanuel,” which means, “God is with us.”
points.apply: When fear tempts you to close your heart this week, pray Mary's words: let it be with me according to your word.

points.h: Holy and blameless before him in love
sub: Chosen before the foundation of the world.
Preserved from sin by the blood of her Son.
q: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no flaw in you.
just as he chose us in Christ before the foundation of the world to be holy and blameless before him in love.
points.apply: Make a good confession soon, asking Mary to help you become what God chose you to be.

q: I treasure your word in my heart, so that I may not sin against you.
Then he went down with them and came to Nazareth, and was obedient to them. His mother treasured all these things in her heart.
points.apply: Each night this week, recall and keep one thing God did that day.

concl: The Immaculate Heart is God's masterpiece and our model: open to the word, faithful in anxiety, keeping what it does not yet understand.
As the apostles prayed with Mary, let us pray with her for the Spirit and for peace.
2027-06-05.resolve: This week, consecrate yourself to the Immaculate Heart, pray a decade of the rosary daily for peace, and treasure God's word each night.

intro: Theme: “He said to her, ‘Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease.’”
The woman in the crowd, the Lord who turns to meet her, and the God of all consolation who comforts us so that we may comfort others.

sub: The Lord near to the brokenhearted.
q: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted, and saves the crushed in spirit.
She had endured much under many physicians, and had spent all that she had; and she was no better, but rather grew worse.
points.apply: Bring to Jesus this week one long burden you have stopped praying about.

sub: The fringe of the garment and the healing wings.
Jesus wants to meet, not only to heal.
q: But for you who revere my name the sun of righteousness shall rise, with healing in its wings.
Immediately aware that power had gone forth from him, Jesus turned about in the crowd and said, “Who touched my clothes?”
points.apply: At your next Holy Qurbana, receive the Lord as one who reaches out in faith, naming what you need him to heal.

sub: From a nameless case to a daughter.
Healed and restored to the people of God.
q: He heals the brokenhearted, and binds up their wounds.
He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be healed of your disease.”
points.apply: Tell the Lord the whole truth about one area of your life in the sacrament of Reconciliation.

q: As a mother comforts her child, so I will comfort you; you shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
who consoles us in all our affliction, so that we may be able to console those who are in any affliction with the consolation with which we ourselves are consoled by God.
points.apply: Visit, call or write to one person who is suffering what you once suffered.

concl: Jesus notices the one touch of faith in the crowd, and he sends us home as sons and daughters, healed and at peace.
The consolation we receive is meant to flow on: let us be apostles of comfort to the unseen.
2027-06-07.resolve: This week, bring one long burden to the Lord, receive the Holy Qurbana as a touch of faith, and console one person who is suffering.

intro: Theme: “And the king will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me.’”
On the feast of St Mariam Thresia: the call that leads into the neighbour's house, faith tested like gold, a life hidden with Christ, and Christ served in the least.

points.h: Go to the land that I will show you
sub: A new road for a young woman of Puthenchira.
q: Now the Lord said to Abram, “Go from your country and your kindred and your father’s house to the land that I will show you.
They asked only one thing, that we remember the poor, which was actually what I was eager to do.
points.apply: Ask the Lord in prayer this week what new step of service he is asking of you.

q: For gold is tested in the fire, and those found acceptable, in the furnace of humiliation.
and it is no longer I who live, but it is Christ who lives in me. And the life I now live in the flesh I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.
points.apply: Offer one present trial to the Lord without complaint, uniting it to his Cross.

sub: Christ in the hungry, the sick and the dying.
The Congregation of the Holy Family.
q: Is it not to share your bread with the hungry, and bring the homeless poor into your house; when you see the naked, to cover them, and not to hide yourself from your own kin?
And the king will answer them, ‘Truly I tell you, just as you did it to one of the least of these who are members of my family, you did it to me.’
points.apply: Visit or help one family in trouble this week.

points.h: The better part and the service of the home
sub: Mary and Martha in one life.
Prayer as the root of service.
q: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your children will be like olive shoots around your table.
there is need of only one thing. Mary has chosen the better part, which will not be taken away from her.”
points.apply: Restore or deepen the evening family prayer in your home, entrusting it to the Holy Family.

concl: St Mariam Thresia followed a new road in obedience, was tested like gold, lived hidden with Christ, and served him in the poorest families.
Her feast calls us to make our homes little Nazareths and to find Christ in the family next door.
2027-06-08.resolve: This week, pray as a family to the Holy Family, accept one trial in peace, and visit or help one family carrying a burden alone.

intro: Theme: “You are the light of the world. A city built on a hill cannot be hid.”
On the feast of Mar Aprem: the Harp of the Spirit, the teacher who entered the cloud like Moses, and the light of a theology lived in service.

points.h: A harp in the hands of the Spirit
sub: God's love poured into our hearts.
Praise as the fruit of Pentecost.
q: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make melody. Awake, my soul! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awake the dawn.
and hope does not disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit that has been given to us.
points.apply: Begin each day this week with one verse of a psalm or hymn sung, not only said.

points.h: A teacher who entered the cloud
sub: Moses, face to face with God.
q: He allowed him to hear his voice, and led him into the dark cloud, and gave him the commandments face to face, the law of life and knowledge, so that he might teach Jacob the covenant, and Israel his decrees.
Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; teach and admonish one another in all wisdom; and with gratitude in your hearts sing psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs to God.
points.apply: Teach a child one hymn or one part of the Holy Qurbana this week.

q: My heart overflows with a goodly theme; I address my verses to the king; my tongue is like the pen of a ready scribe.
In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
points.apply: Do one hidden work of mercy for the hungry or the sick this week.

concl: Mar Aprem shows what the Spirit does in a heart: he makes it sing, teach and serve.
Let us love the Syriac heritage we have received, sing our faith, and let our light shine in good works.
2027-06-09.resolve: This week, sing one hymn at home each day, teach one part of the Qurbana to a child, and do one hidden work of mercy.

intro: Theme: “But she answered him, ‘Sir, even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.’”
The faith of a foreign mother, the table opened to all nations, and the one God and one Lord whom we confess with love that builds up.

sub: The Creed we pray each Sunday.
q: Hear, O Israel: The Lord is our God, the Lord alone. You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.
yet for us there is one God, the Father, from whom are all things and for whom we exist, and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things and through whom we exist.
points.apply: Pray the Creed slowly once each day this week.

points.h: Knowledge puffs up, love builds up
q: He has told you, O mortal, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
Now concerning food sacrificed to idols: we know that “all of us possess knowledge.” Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.
points.apply: In one discussion about faith this week, choose to encourage rather than to win.

points.h: Even the dogs eat the crumbs
sub: A mother who would not give up.
A table that is enough for all nations.
q: for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
But she answered him, “Sir, even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”
points.apply: Choose one intention for a struggling young person and pray for it every day this week without giving up.

concl: A foreign mother's humble, persistent faith opened the table of the Lord; the apostles carried that bread to the nations, and to us.
Let us confess the one God and the one Lord with love that builds up, and pray without giving up for those we love.
2027-06-10.resolve: This week, pray the Creed slowly each day, encourage rather than argue, and pray with persistence for one young person.

intro: Theme: “for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were brought to the Lord.”
On the feast of St Barnabas: the son of encouragement who trusted Saul, rejoiced at God's grace, was sent by the Spirit, and gave Mark a second chance.

sub: A field sold for the poor.
q: Strengthen the weak hands, and make firm the feeble knees.
There was a Levite, a native of Cyprus, Joseph, to whom the apostles gave the name Barnabas (which means “son of encouragement”).
points.apply: Each day this week, encourage one person who is struggling.

points.h: He saw the grace of God and rejoiced
sub: A good man, full of the Spirit.
Antioch, where the disciples were first called Christians.
q: O give thanks to the Lord, call on his name, make known his deeds among the peoples.
for he was a good man, full of the Holy Spirit and of faith. And a great many people were brought to the Lord.
points.apply: Before criticising anything new in the Church this week, look for God's grace in it and give thanks.

sub: Mission born in worship and fasting.
The right hand of fellowship and the poor.
q: Then I heard the voice of the Lord saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” And I said, “Here am I; send me!”
While they were worshiping the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.”
points.apply: Pray and fast one day this week for missionaries and for vocations.

points.h: Sheep among wolves, and a second chance
sub: Wise as serpents, innocent as doves.
q: Say to those who are of a fearful heart, “Be strong, do not fear! Here is your God. He will come with vengeance, with terrible recompense. He will come and save you.”
“See, I am sending you out like sheep into the midst of wolves; so be wise as serpents and innocent as doves.
points.apply: Offer a concrete second chance to someone who has failed you.

concl: Barnabas shows us the apostle as encourager: generous, welcoming, joyful at grace, sent by the Spirit, ready to begin again with those who fail.
Let us be sons and daughters of encouragement in our homes and parishes.
2027-06-11.resolve: This week, encourage one person daily, look for grace before faults, pray for missionaries, and give one second chance.

intro: Theme: “Moved with pity, Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, and said to him, ‘I do choose. Be made clean!’”
The leper's prayer, the touch of Jesus who takes the outcast's place, and the apostles who spread the fragrance of Christ.

points.h: If you choose, you can make me clean
sub: Leaving the decision to the Lord's will.
q: He shall remain unclean as long as he has the disease; he is unclean. He shall live alone; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
A leper came to him begging him, and kneeling he said to him, “If you choose, you can make me clean.”
points.apply: Bring to the Lord this week, in confession, the area of your life where you feel unclean.

points.h: I do choose. Be made clean!
sub: Holiness that passes to the unclean.
q: So he went down and immersed himself seven times in the Jordan, according to the word of the man of God; his flesh was restored like the flesh of a young boy, and he was clean.
Moved with pity, Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, and said to him, “I do choose. Be made clean!”
points.apply: Greet, visit or help one person whom others avoid this week.

sub: A fragrance from life to life.
Not peddlers, but persons of sincerity.
q: Let my prayer be counted as incense before you, and the lifting up of my hands as an evening sacrifice.
For we are the aroma of Christ to God among those who are being saved and among those who are perishing;
points.apply: Change the atmosphere of your home or workplace this week by refusing gossip and choosing kind words.

concl: Jesus wills our healing: he touches what is unclean and takes the outcast's place so that we may come home.
Touched by him, we become messengers and the aroma of Christ wherever we go.
2027-06-12.resolve: This week, make a good confession, reach out to one person others avoid, and let your words spread the fragrance of Christ.

intro: Theme: “I have said this to you, so that in me you may have peace. In the world you face persecution. But take courage; I have conquered the world!”
An apostle crushed beyond his strength, the prayers of many that carry him, and the Lord who is never alone and has conquered the world.

points.h: Crushed, so as to rely on God
sub: Even an apostle has a breaking point.
The God who raises the dead.
q: Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I fear no evil; for you are with me; your rod and your staff… they comfort me.
Indeed, we felt that we had received the sentence of death so that we would rely not on ourselves but on God who raises the dead.
points.apply: Name what crushes you most and pray daily this week for God to raise you up from it.

q: But Moses’ hands grew weary; so they took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. Aaron and Hur held up his hands, one on one side, and the other on the other side; so his hands were steady until the sun set.
as you also join in helping us by your prayers, so that many will give thanks on our behalf for the blessing granted us through the prayers of many.
points.apply: Pray each evening for three suffering people by name, and tell one of them.

points.h: Take courage, I have conquered the world
sub: Scattered disciples, a Lord never alone.
Victory announced on the eve of the Cross.
q: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they shall not overwhelm you; when you walk through fire you shall not be burned, and the flame shall not consume you.
I have said this to you, so that in me you may have peace. In the world you face persecution. But take courage; I have conquered the world!”
points.apply: Bring your heaviest burden to the next Holy Qurbana and leave it with the Lord who has conquered the world.

concl: God allows us to reach the end of our strength so that we may rely on him who raises the dead.
We are never alone: the Father is with the Son, the Church carries us in prayer, and Christ has conquered the world.
2027-06-14.resolve: This week, pray daily for God to raise you up from what crushes you, carry three suffering people in prayer, and take courage in Christ's victory.

intro: Theme: “the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised, and the poor have good news brought to them.”
John's question from prison, the signs of the kingdom, and a faith centred on Christ rather than on human regulations.

sub: The elemental spirits of the universe.
Discipline that flows from union with Christ.
q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
If with Christ you died to the elemental spirits of the universe, why do you live as if you still belonged to the world?
points.apply: Offer one small fast this week consciously in union with Christ, and give up one practice born of fear rather than faith.

points.h: Are you the one who is to come?
sub: When God does not act as we expect.
q: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf unstopped; then the lame shall leap like a deer, and the tongue of the speechless sing for joy.
and said to him, “Are you the one who is to come, or are we to wait for another?”
points.apply: Bring your deepest question to Jesus in prayer this week instead of keeping it to yourself.

points.h: Blessed is anyone who takes no offense at me
sub: Becoming a sign of the kingdom.
q: The spirit of the Lord God is upon me, because the Lord has anointed me; he has sent me to bring good news to the oppressed,
And blessed is anyone who takes no offense at me.”
points.apply: Do one act of mercy for a poor or sick person this week, so that someone sees a sign of Christ.

concl: Our faith is not a system of rules or fears but a person, Jesus, the one who is to come.
He shows himself in the signs of mercy; blessed are we if we do not stumble over his humility.
2027-06-15.resolve: This week, offer a small fast in union with Christ, bring your hardest question to him in prayer, and become a sign of his kingdom for someone in need.

intro: Theme: “But law came in, with the result that the trespass multiplied; but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,”
Adam and Christ, the grace that overflows, and the beloved Son rejected who became the cornerstone.

sub: Sin and death entered the world.
We are born into a wounded humanity.
Adam, a type of the one who was to come.
q: but through the devil’s envy death entered the world, and those who belong to his company experience it.
Therefore, just as sin came into the world through one man, and death came through sin, and so death spread to all because all have sinned
points.apply: Examine your conscience tonight honestly, without fear, knowing that grace is greater.

sub: The obedience of the Second Adam.
Grace that overflows, not a small repair.
q: Come now, let us argue it out, says the Lord: though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be like snow; though they are red like crimson, they shall become like wool.
But law came in, with the result that the trespass multiplied; but where sin increased, grace abounded all the more,
points.apply: Bring a long-held sin to the sacrament of Reconciliation this week.

points.h: The beloved son and the rejected stone
sub: The Son thrown out of the vineyard.
The cornerstone of our salvation, and the fruit he seeks from us.
q: The stone that the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone.
He had still one other, a beloved son. Finally he sent him to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
points.apply: Give God one concrete fruit this week: prayer, reconciliation, alms or a visit.

concl: Through Adam we share a wound; through Christ, the Second Adam, grace abounds much more.
The rejected Son is the cornerstone; we, the tenants of his vineyard, are asked for fruit.
2027-06-16.resolve: This week, trust that grace is greater than your sin, go to confession if needed, and give the Owner of the vineyard one concrete fruit.

intro: Theme: “It is the spirit that gives life; the flesh is useless. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life.”
The call to share the divine nature, the ladder from faith to love, and the hard teaching of the bread of life opened by the Spirit.

sub: Everything needed for life and godliness.
Becoming by grace what he is by nature.
Baptism, the Holy Qurbana, and glory.
q: I say, “You are gods, children of the Most High, all of you;

Thus he has given us, through these things, his precious and very great promises, so that through them you may escape from the corruption that is in the world because of lust, and may become participants of the divine nature.
points.apply: Each morning this week, before anything else, thank God for the gift of sharing his life.

points.h: From faith to love, rung by rung
sub: The ordinary virtues in the middle.
Never forget the cleansing of Baptism.
q: But the path of the righteous is like the light of dawn, which shines brighter and brighter until full day.

For this very reason, you must make every effort to support your faith with goodness, and goodness with knowledge, and knowledge with self-control, and self-control with endurance, and endurance with godliness, and godliness with mutual affection, and mutual affection with love.
points.apply: Practise daily this week the virtue on Peter's ladder that you most lack.

sub: The flesh of the Son of Man who ascends.
Lord, to whom can we go?
q: I will put my spirit within you, and you shall live, and I will place you on your own soil; then you shall know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will act, says the Lord.”
It is the spirit that gives life; the flesh is useless. The words that I have spoken to you are spirit and life.
points.apply: Pray to the Holy Spirit for five minutes before your next Holy Qurbana.

concl: God calls us to share his own life, and gives us everything needed to climb from faith to love.
When his teaching is hard, the Spirit gives life, and with Peter we stay with the One who has the words of eternal life.
2027-06-17.resolve: This week, thank God each morning for his life in you, practise one virtue daily, and prepare for Holy Communion with prayer to the Holy Spirit.

intro: Theme: “but in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be ready to make your defense to anyone who demands from you an accounting for the hope that is in you;”
Witness without fear, an account of hope given with gentleness, Christ who suffered once for all, and the patience of the Lord of the harvest.

points.h: Blessed when you suffer for doing right
sub: Do not fear what they fear.
Sanctify Christ as Lord in your hearts.
A clear conscience and a good life.
q: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?
But even if you do suffer for doing what is right, you are blessed. Do not fear what they fear, and do not be intimidated,
points.apply: When you are misunderstood for your faith this week, answer with a prayer before you answer with words.

points.h: An account of hope, with gentleness and reverence
sub: Christ suffered once for all to bring us to God.
q: A soft answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
but in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord. Always be ready to make your defense to anyone who demands from you an accounting for the hope that is in you;
points.apply: Write down in a few sentences why you hope in Christ, so that you are ready when someone asks.

points.h: Let both grow until the harvest
sub: The patience of God with the mixed field.
The righteous will shine like the sun.
q: Through such works you have taught your people that the righteous must be kind, and you have filled your children with good hope, because you give repentance for sins.
Let both of them grow together until the harvest; and at harvest time I will tell the reapers, Collect the weeds first and bind them in bundles to be burned, but gather the wheat into my barn.’”
points.apply: Pray each day this week for someone you had written off, and pull out one weed in your own heart.

concl: With Christ enthroned in our hearts we need not fear; we give an account of our hope with gentleness, as he suffered for us with love.
The Lord of the harvest is patient: we leave the judgement to him, and by his grace weeds may yet become wheat.
2027-06-18.resolve: This week, prepare a short account of your hope, answer every question about your faith with gentleness, and pray daily for someone you had given up on.

intro: Theme: “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put in more than all those who are contributing to the treasury.”
The holy law that shows us our sin, the grace of the Spirit that fulfils it, and the widow who gives her whole life.

sub: A lamp that shows what is in the room.
You shall not covet: the commandment of the heart.
Sin, the parasite that twists the good.
q: The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the soul;
So the law is holy, and the commandment is holy and just and good.
points.apply: Pray the Ten Commandments slowly tonight as an examination of conscience, pausing at the tenth.

sub: The Spirit of Pentecost writes the law on the heart.
q: If you do well, will you not be accepted? And if you do not do well, sin is lurking at the door; its desire is for you, but you must master it.
Wretched man that I am! Who will rescue me from this body of death?
points.apply: Each time you feel envy this week, say: “Come, Holy Spirit,” and thank God for one gift you have.

points.h: All she had to live on
sub: The Lord who watches the treasury.
The widow, a picture of Christ.
q: Whoever is kind to the poor lends to the Lord, and will be repaid in full.
For all of them have contributed out of their abundance; but she out of her poverty has put in everything she had, all she had to live on.
points.apply: Make one hidden gift this week that costs you something real.

concl: The law is holy, but only the Spirit can make us keep it from the heart.
The widow gave her whole life, as Christ gave his: let us bring our whole lives to the altar.
2027-06-19.resolve: This week, examine your heart with the tenth commandment, call on the Holy Spirit when envy rises, and make one hidden gift that costs you something.

intro: Theme: “For out of the abundance of the heart the mouth speaks.”
The unsearchable ways of the God who shows mercy to all, the tree known by its fruit, and the account we will give for every word.

sub: Mercy for Gentile and Jew alike.
The gifts and calling of God are irrevocable.
q: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, nor are your ways my ways, says the Lord.
O the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments and how inscrutable his ways!
points.apply: When something in your life makes no sense this week, pray Paul's hymn instead of complaining.

points.h: The tree is known by its fruit
sub: A good tree, a good fruit.
q: They are like trees planted by streams of water, which yield their fruit in its season, and their leaves do not wither.
Either make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad; for the tree is known by its fruit.
points.apply: Plant God's word in your heart: read one verse each morning and repeat it during the day.

sub: Justified or condemned by our words.
q: Death and life are in the power of the tongue, and those who love it will eat its fruits.
for by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.
points.apply: For one day, say nothing about an absent person that you would not say to their face.

concl: God's ways are beyond us, but his mercy is for all: we trust and give him glory.
The heart is the root and our words are the fruit: fill the heart with God, and the tongue will bless.
2027-06-21.resolve: This week, trust God where you cannot understand, plant one verse of Scripture in your heart each day, and keep one day without a careless word.

intro: Theme: “Yet if any of you suffers as a Christian, do not consider it a disgrace, but glorify God because you bear this name.”
The tent of the body and the house from God, the lamp on the lampstand, and two martyrs who served their king but God first.

points.h: A house not made with hands
sub: We groan, longing to be further clothed.
q: For I know that my Redeemer lives, and that at the last he will stand upon the earth;
For we know that if the earthly tent we live in is destroyed, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal in the heavens.
points.apply: Visit or call someone who is seriously ill this week, and pray with them for the hope of the resurrection.

sub: Nothing hidden that will not come to light.
q: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
He said to them, “Is a lamp brought in to be put under the bushel basket, or under the bed, and not on the lampstand?
points.apply: Let your faith be seen in one concrete act at work, school or in public this week.

points.h: The king's good servant, but God's first
sub: The Spirit who speaks before governors and kings.
q: But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods and we will not worship the golden statue that you have set up.
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than any human authority.
points.apply: Examine where you are pressed to act against conscience, and ask St Thomas More for courage to say no with kindness.

concl: Our body is a tent, but God has given us his Spirit as a pledge of an eternal house.
Like Sts John Fisher and Thomas More, let us set our lamp on the lampstand, serve our country well and God first.
2027-06-22.resolve: This week, pray for the dying and the persecuted, let your faith be seen in one act, and refuse one thing that goes against your conscience.

intro: Theme: “Just so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner who repents.”
A clear conscience before God and people, the God who searches his house for one lost coin, and the joy of heaven over one who repents.

sub: Accused of saying yes and no.
Not by earthly wisdom, but by grace.
q: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my thoughts.
Indeed, this is our boast, the testimony of our conscience: we have behaved in the world with frankness and godly sincerity, not by earthly wisdom but by the grace of God
points.apply: Make an honest examination of conscience tonight on one area: money, work or promises.

points.h: She lights a lamp and searches
sub: God who searches the corners of his own house.
The image of the King on the coin.
q: I will seek the lost, and I will bring back the strayed, and I will bind up the injured, and I will strengthen the weak,
Or what woman having ten silver coins, if she loses one of them, does not light a lamp, sweep the house, and search carefully until she finds it?
points.apply: Visit, call or write to one person who has drifted away, without reproach.

sub: Joy that cannot be kept private.
John the Baptist, herald of repentance.
q: The Lord, your God, is in your midst, a warrior who gives victory; he will rejoice over you with gladness, he will renew you in his love; he will exult over you with loud singing
When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the coin that I had lost.’
points.apply: Go to confession before Sts Peter and Paul, and welcome warmly anyone who returns to the parish.

concl: Our boast is a clear conscience, given by grace and kept in the light.
God searches for every lost coin and heaven rejoices over each one found: let us be found, and let us search with him.
2027-06-23.resolve: This week, examine your conscience honestly, reach out to one person who has drifted away, and give heaven the joy of a good confession.

intro: Theme: “All who heard them pondered them and said, ‘What then will this child become?’ For, indeed, the hand of the Lord was with him.”
On the Birth of John the Baptist: a life known before birth, a name given by grace, a prophet who speaks truth to kings, and the last of the prophets who hands us over to the Son.

points.h: Before I formed you in the womb
sub: Filled with the Spirit before birth.
Every child in the womb is known by God.
q: Before I formed you in the womb I knew you, and before you were born I consecrated you; I appointed you a prophet to the nations.
for he will be great in the sight of the Lord. He must never drink wine or strong drink; even before his birth he will be filled with the Holy Spirit.
points.apply: Pray daily this week for unborn children and their mothers, and support one family expecting a child.

sub: The family's plan and God's plan.
q: The Lord called me before I was born, while I was in my mother’s womb he named me.
He asked for a writing tablet and wrote, “His name is John.” And all of them were amazed.
points.apply: Find out the meaning of your baptismal name and read the life of your patron saint.

q: Nathan said to David, “You are the man!
For John had been telling Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”
points.apply: Listen to your conscience this week and make a good confession.

sub: Point to the Lamb and step aside.
q: Lo, I will send you the prophet Elijah before the great and terrible day of the Lord comes.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
points.apply: In one conversation this week, speak of Jesus rather than of yourself.

concl: John was known and named by God before his birth, and so is every child: let us welcome life and live by the name God gave us.
Like John, let us speak the truth with courage, point to the Lamb of God, and decrease so that Christ may increase.
2027-06-24.resolve: This week, pray for the unborn, learn the meaning of your name, answer your conscience with a good confession, and point one person to Jesus.

intro: Theme: “Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
Authority as God's servant for the good of the people, the human person as God's coin, and the conscience that puts God first.

sub: Order and law within God's providence.
The ruler as God's servant for your good.
q: By me kings reign, and rulers decree what is just;
Let every person be subject to the governing authorities; for there is no authority except from God, and those authorities that exist have been instituted by God.
points.apply: Pray by name this week for one person who governs your village, town, state or country.

points.h: Give to God the things that are God's
sub: Caesar may ask for taxes, not for the soul.
q: So God created humankind in his image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
They answered, “The emperor’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to the emperor the things that are the emperor’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”
points.apply: Offer your whole day back to God each night this week.

sub: Not only because of wrath but because of conscience.
No bribe given, no bribe taken.
When a law commands sin: obey God.
q: But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods and we will not worship the golden statue that you have set up.”
But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than any human authority.”
points.apply: Put right one small dishonesty toward the public or the state this week.

concl: Order, law and public service are gifts of God's providence; we serve them as honest citizens and pray for those who govern.
But we bear God's image, and so we belong to him first and always.
2027-06-25.resolve: This week, pay what is due with a clean conscience, pray for those in authority, and give yourself back to God each night.

intro: Theme: “Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment.”
The Church as the bride promised to Christ, the danger of another Jesus and another gospel, and the right judgment that sees the heart.

points.h: Promised in marriage to one husband
sub: The Church, a bride and not a club.
q: And I will take you for my wife forever; I will take you for my wife in righteousness and in justice, in steadfast love, and in mercy.
I feel a divine jealousy for you, for I promised you in marriage to one husband, to present you as a chaste virgin to Christ.
points.apply: Renew your baptismal promises quietly in prayer one evening this week.

sub: Staying with the faith of the apostles.
q: Thus says the Lord of hosts: Do not listen to the words of the prophets who prophesy to you; they are deluding you. They speak visions of their own minds, not from the mouth of the Lord.
But I am afraid that as the serpent deceived Eve by its cunning, your thoughts will be led astray from a sincere and pure devotion to Christ.
points.apply: Test one religious message you receive this week by the Creed and the teaching of the Church.

q: But the Lord said to Samuel, “Do not look on his appearance or on the height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for the Lord does not see as mortals see; they look on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart.”
Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment.
points.apply: Do one kind act for someone you had judged by appearance.

concl: We are a bride promised to Christ: let our devotion be sincere and pure, faithful to the Jesus of the apostles.
Like Mary, let us see as God sees, looking on the heart.
2027-06-26.resolve: This week, renew your love for Christ, test every new voice by the faith of the Church, and correct one rash judgment by an act of kindness.

intro: Theme: “But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything, and remind you of all that I have said to you.”
On the commemoration of St Irenaeus: the shepherd who carries his people on his heart, the faith that is received and handed on, the mercy that forgives and consoles, and the One greater than Jonah.

q: So have no fear; I myself will provide for you and your little ones.” In this way he reassured them, speaking kindly to them.
so now instead you should forgive and console him, so that he may not be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
points.apply: Console one person this week who has been made to feel the weight of their wrongdoing.

q: And the people of Nineveh believed God; they proclaimed a fast, and everyone, great and small, put on sackcloth.
The people of Nineveh will rise up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it, because they repented at the proclamation of Jonah, and see, something greater than Jonah is here!
points.apply: Make one concrete act of repentance this week instead of asking God for signs.

q: So Aaron shall bear the names of the sons of Israel in the breastpiece of judgment on his heart when he goes into the holy place, for a continual remembrance before the Lord.
“I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
points.apply: Pray each day this week for your bishop and your parish priest by name.

points.h: Continue in what you have learned
q: For the lips of a priest should guard knowledge, and people should seek instruction from his mouth, for he is the messenger of the Lord of hosts.
But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you everything, and remind you of all that I have said to you.
points.apply: Thank God by name for those who handed on the faith to you, and contact one of them.

concl: St Irenaeus received the faith from those who knew the apostles and handed it on whole; he made peace in the Church.
Let us forgive and console, repent at the word of the One greater than Jonah, and continue in what we have learned.
2027-06-28.resolve: This week, console someone, make one act of repentance, pray for your shepherds by name, and thank those who taught you the faith.

intro: Theme: “Whoever is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much; and whoever is dishonest in a very little is dishonest also in much.”
The calling that reaches us in every condition of life, the dignity of those bought with a price, and the choice between God and wealth.

points.h: Lead the life to which God called you
q: But seek the welfare of the city where I have sent you into exile, and pray to the Lord on its behalf, for in its welfare you will find your welfare.
However that may be, let each of you lead the life that the Lord has assigned, to which God called you. This is my rule in all the churches.
points.apply: Offer your work to God each morning this week and do one part of it with special care.

sub: Slave and master equal before Christ.
q: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt; they shall not be sold as slaves are sold.
You were bought with a price; do not become slaves of human masters.
points.apply: Name one human master you serve, of opinion, habit or money, and take one step away from it.

points.h: You cannot serve God and wealth
q: Remove far from me falsehood and lying; give me neither poverty nor riches; feed me with the food that I need,
No slave can serve two masters; for a slave will either hate the one and love the other, or be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.
points.apply: Give to someone who cannot repay you, and refuse one expense that is only for show.

concl: God calls us where we are; bought by Christ, we belong to no other master.
Faithful in little and generous with what we have, we serve God alone, as the apostles and the first martyrs did.
2027-06-30.resolve: This week, offer your daily work to God, refuse one form of slavery, and use your money to make a friend among the poor.
